svg.title: Track Domains Through One Nested Annual Cohort
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-annual-domain-cohort-funnel; chart type: funnel; title: Track Domains Through One Nested Annual Cohort; subtitle: Count unique domains, not messages, leads, or auction impressions.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative annual cohort: 400 researched domains, 100 screen-cleared domains, 40 owned and listed domains, 20 with qualified inquiries, and eight completed sales. Each stage is a subset of the preceding stage. Existing holdings may enter the researched cohort; listing is not necessarily a current-year acquisition.; caption: Eight sales at an assumed $20,000 average produce the $160,000 Base-Case gross revenue. The implied 20% annual sell-through of 40 listed domains is a demanding modeling assumption, not a market benchmark.; stages: label: Researched domains; value: 400 unique domains; complete cohort; numeric value: 400.0; detail: Deduplicate by domain and retain a dated record of comparable sales, intended use, carrying cost, and seller or auction provenance.; label: Screen-cleared domains; value: 100 domains; 25% of researched cohort; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Retain only domains passing documented rights, historical-use, pricing, and transferability checks; screen clearance does not authorize an unlimited bid.; label: Owned and listed domains; value: 40 domains; 40% of cleared subset; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Confirm control of every listed name, synchronize prices across venues, and remove stale listings immediately after a sale or ownership change.; label: Domains with qualified inquiries; value: 20 domains; 50% of listed subset; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Count each domain once after a buyer demonstrates a credible use case and willingness to discuss price; exclude automated spam and duplicate contacts.; label: Completed domain sales; value: 8 domains; 40% of inquiry subset; numeric value: 8.0; detail: Count only completed transactions; eight multiplied by $20,000 equals $160,000 gross proceeds, with acquisition and operating costs deducted separately.

text.title: Track Domains Through One Nested Annual Cohort
text.tspan: Track Domains Through One Nested Annual Cohort

circle.title: label: Researched domains; value: 400 unique domains; complete cohort; numeric value: 400.0; detail: Deduplicate by domain and retain a dated record of comparable sales, intended use, carrying cost, and seller or auction provenance.

label: Screen-cleared domains; value: 100 domains; 25% of researched cohort; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Retain only domains passing documented rights, historical-use, pricing, and transferability checks; screen clearance does not authorize an unlimited bid.

label: Owned and listed domains; value: 40 domains; 40% of cleared subset; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Confirm control of every listed name, synchronize prices across venues, and remove stale listings immediately after a sale or ownership change.

label: Domains with qualified inquiries; value: 20 domains; 50% of listed subset; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Count each domain once after a buyer demonstrates a credible use case and willingness to discuss price; exclude automated spam and duplicate contacts.

label: Completed domain sales; value: 8 domains; 40% of inquiry subset; numeric value: 8.0; detail: Count only completed transactions; eight multiplied by $20,000 equals $160,000 gross proceeds, with acquisition and operating costs deducted separately.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative annual cohort: 400 researched domains, 100 screen-cleared domains, 40 owned and listed domains, 20 with qualified inquiries, and eight completed sales. Each stage is a subset of the preceding stage. Existing holdings may enter the researched cohort; listing is not necessarily a current-year acquisition.
